steps: Step 1: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_dashboard.py with GET /dashboard endpoint that aggregates User, Chat, ChatFeedback counts from MongoDB (total_users, active_today using updated_at/created_at, total_messages from Chat collection, pro_users/free_users from subscription_tier field, signups_today). Include daily time-series arrays for chat_fallbacks, latency, token_spend (placeholders with source:placeholder when PostHog not connected). Also include GET /health (detailed dependency check), GET /alerts/unacknowledged-count (from alerts collection), GET /cf-overview (placeholder CF stats).

Step 2: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_content.py with GET /content/draft-served-subjects (query subjects collection where status=draft), PATCH /content/subjects/:id (update subject fields), POST /content/regenerate-sitemap (placeholder), POST /content/auto-heal (placeholder), GET /content/version-history/:chapterId (query version history).

Step 3: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_users.py with GET /users (paginated, searchable by name/email, filterable), PATCH /users/:id/status, PATCH /users/:id/plan, PATCH /users/:id/role, PATCH /users/:id/credits, GET /users/:id/quiz-quota, POST /users/:id/quiz-quota/reset, GET /users/churn-risk (placeholder analytics).

Step 4: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_conversations.py with GET /conversations (paginated list from Chat collection with user info), GET /conversations/extract-faqs (placeholder AI extraction), GET /conversations/sentiment (aggregate from feedback), POST /conversations/:id/flag, POST /sync-conversations (placeholder).

Step 5: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_seo.py with all SEO endpoints returning placeholder/mock data with source:placeholder field. Endpoints: entity status/history/refresh, health-history, health-snapshot, deep-scan-history, google-indexing-stats, pipeline-status, sitemap-validate, topic-discovery CRUD, remediation CRUD, internal-links CRUD, inject-schema, prewarm-coverage, google-sitemap-ping, indexnow smoke/history, daily-summary-dispatches.

Step 6: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_analytics.py with GET /analytics (overview aggregation from MongoDB), GET /analytics/daily (time-series from Chat/User created_at), GET /analytics/revenue (from user subscription data), GET /analytics/predictor (placeholder), GET /analytics/cf-status, POST /analytics/cf-recheck, GET /analytics/cf-overview, GET /analytics/bot-traffic, GET /analytics/hydrate-stats, GET /analytics/review-prompt-stats (+ baseline-noise, by-reason-trend), GET /analytics/content-card-views, GET /analytics/page-conversions, GET /analytics/funnel, GET /analytics/cf-ai-crawl-control, POST /analytics/review-prompt-weekly-digest/send.

Step 7: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_settings.py with GET /settings (from a site_settings MongoDB collection), PATCH /settings (update), GET /diagnostics, POST /break-glass/disable, roadmap CRUD (GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /roadmap), GET/PUT /plan-config, GET/PUT /api-config, GET /activity-log, POST /cache/purge-all.

Step 8: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_notifications.py with GET /notifications (list from notifications collection), POST /notifications (create+broadcast), notifications/triggers CRUD, GET/PUT /notification-prefs, GET /push/delivery-stats, IndexNow endpoints (ping, status, backfill-all, backfill-progress, submit-urls, history).

Step 9: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_ai.py with GET /vertex/health (check Vertex AI config status), GET /vertex/probe-status, GET /intelligence/overview (AI provider summary), GET /kv-health, GET /r2-storage-health, GET /ci-status, GA4 endpoints (status, auth-url, test).

Step 10: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_revenue.py with GET /monetization/overview (aggregate subscription revenue from users), GET /monetization/referral-config, ads endpoints (overview, earnings CRUD, CSV upload, adsense status/sync).

Step 11: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_security.py with GET /security/spoofed-bots, GET /security/blocked-ips, GET /security/block-trends, POST /security/block-ip, POST /security/unblock-ip, GET /security/ttl-monitor, GET /security/collection-size-history.

Step 12: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_alerts.py with GET /alerts (paginated, filterable), GET /alerts/unacknowledged-count, PATCH /alerts/:id/acknowledge, PATCH /alerts/acknowledge-all, POST /alerts/backfill-thresholds, GET /alerts/cooldowns, DELETE /alerts/cooldowns/:key, GET/PUT /alert-settings, POST /alert-settings/test-delivery.

Step 13: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_logs.py with GET /logs (paginated, filterable structured logs), GET /logs/trace/:correlationId, GET /logs/status, POST /logs/pause, POST /logs/resume, POST /logs/rotate-token, DELETE /logs, GET /logs/export.

Step 14: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_syra.py with POST /syra/chat (placeholder AI chat), GET /syra/actions, POST /syra/execute-action, GET/PUT /syra/prefs, GET /syra/briefing, POST /syra/stt (placeholder), POST /syra/tts (placeholder), POST /cms/ai-suggest (placeholder).
Step 15: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/admin_pipeline.py with POST /pipeline/auto-generate (placeholder), GET /pipeline/status/:jobId (placeholder), POST /d1-sync (placeholder).

Step 16: Update apps/backend/app/main.py to import and register all new admin routers under the /api/v1/admin prefix. Add imports for admin_dashboard, admin_content, admin_users, admin_conversations, admin_seo, admin_analytics, admin_settings, admin_notifications, admin_ai, admin_revenue, admin_security, admin_alerts, admin_logs, admin_syra, admin_pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: All new router files exist and can be imported without errors
main.py imports and registers all new routers
Mutating endpoints (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) call _csrf_check(request)
Endpoints that require external services not available return placeholder data with source:placeholder field
The app starts without errors (python -c 'from app.main import app')
GET /admin/dashboard returns aggregated stats structure matching what AdminDashboard.jsx expects
GET /admin/users returns paginated user list with search/filter support
GET /admin/conversations returns chat sessions with user info
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print(len(app.routes))' to confirm app boots with all routes
Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x --timeout=30 to confirm no test regressions
